svg.aria-label: Index card. Kaavalu: catches scam calls as they happen. Android app that spots a ‘digital arrest’ scam while the call is still going, warns the person in their own language and texts their family. Key result: no call recording, no blocklists. App Lab, Kalpavikas 2.0. Kotlin, ML Kit.
